metadata.title: Figures, Tables, and Long Captions in an Offline Reader

content_items.text: Figures, Tables, and Long Captions in an Offline Reader
This compact fixture verifies image placement, table rendering, long captions, and nearby highlighted evidence.
The first visual summarizes a deterministic three-stage engineering pipeline and is the primary result in this fixture.

image_caption: A deliberately long engineering caption explains input normalization, deterministic rendering, and final visual inspection without hiding the relationship between the figure and its supporting paragraph.

content_items.text: The paragraph immediately after the figure should remain adjacent when the reader switches to focus mode.

table_caption: Table 1. Deterministic timing checkpoints for the three review stages.

content_items.text: The structured table remains readable and does not force the article to overflow horizontally.
Together, the visual assets provide a stable regression case for captions and modal enlargement.

translations.translation_zh: 离线阅读器中的图、表与长图注
该紧凑样例验证图片位置、表格渲染、长图注和邻近重点证据。
第一幅图概括确定性的三阶段工程流程，是本样例的主要结果。
长图注说明输入归一化、确定性渲染和最终视觉检查，并保持图与支撑段落之间的关系。
紧邻图片的段落在切换到重点模式时仍应保持相邻。
表1：三个审核阶段的确定性时间检查点。
结构化表格保持可读，并且不会迫使正文横向溢出。
这些视觉资产共同构成图注和弹窗放大的稳定回归案例。

research_question.text: 图表、长图注和邻近重点能否在离线 reader 中稳定呈现？

key_methods.text: 使用一张矢量图和一个结构化表格覆盖两类资产。

core_results.text: 图、表、图注和支撑段落形成可重复的布局案例。

limitations.text: 微型资产只用于回归，不评估真实论文图像质量。
